scene: The open gondola rises steadily through glowing neon mist into misty skies.
beats: You crank the grooved winch briskly, speeding the climb until the gondola docks beside a humming cloud condenser and the gate clicks open.
You squeegee a clear circle through sudsy glass, revealing rainbow sprinklers just as the gondola bumps safely to a halt and slides its door wide.
The sleepy crow caws softly, nudging a brass rain-token into your palm as the gondola settles beside giant wooden cisterns and unlatches its gate.
picture: A flat side view inside the metal-railed window-cleaner gondola. On the far left sits a bronze gear crank. The player stands left of centre in orange corduroy and beanie. In the centre, a goggled crow rests on a toolbox. On the right, a sudsy glass pane faces outward toward rising rooftop silos.
shown: a heavy bronze gear crank mounted on the far left railing
a foam-coated glass windscreen on the right side of the deck
a black crow wearing goggles roosting on a tool crate in the centre

after.label: Stay on
after.beat: You stay aboard as cool mist tickles your cheeks, riding past the stop to the terminal. After switching to the night funicular, you roll gently into the starry chatter of Comet Watch Rooftop.
after.then: Step off at Comet Watch Rooftop

variants.scene: The clanking maintenance platform lifts into twilight among wet rooftop tanks.
beats: You turn the sturdy gear handle, accelerating your rise until the lift aligns with a humming cloud condenser and the gate swings open.
You drag the squeegee across wet soap to spot sparkling rainbow sprinklers, right as the platform bumps to a stop and opens its door.
The crow chirps warmly and drops a brass rain-token into your hand while the carriage settles by giant wooden cisterns, unlatching its gate.
variants.ride_on: You stay aboard while cool vapor drifts past your ears, riding all the way to the end. Transferring to the night funicular, you glide up into bustling Comet Watch Rooftop.

variants.scene: Cool lavender smog swirls around the open lift as you hum {tune}.
beats: Muscling the bronze wheel round and round speeds your ascent, docking smoothly beside a humming cloud condenser as the latch clicks free.
A brisk swipe of the rubber blade exposes brilliant rainbow sprinklers just as the lift thuds into place and slides open.
You gently stroke glossy feathers; the bird gifts you a tiny brass rain-token as the gondola reaches giant wooden cisterns, releasing its gate.
variants.ride_on: Remaining on the lift, you let damp breezes swirl around your beanie. You catch the connecting night funicular at the depot, climbing smoothly into glowing Comet Watch Rooftop.

variants.scene: Ropes creak gently as the steel scaffold floats past high brick chimneys.
beats: Spinning the geared handle quickens your travel skyward, pulling up next to a humming cloud condenser where the entry gate clicks wide.
Wiping a clear circle through thick lather reveals joyful rainbow sprinklers just as the vessel docks safely and pushes its door open.
A quiet caw sounds as the goggled bird nudges a brass rain-token into your fingers, the car mooring by giant wooden cisterns with an open gate.
variants.ride_on: You breeze right past the landing into the quiet terminal. Hopping onto the rumbling night funicular, you coast upward to the sparkling chatter of Comet Watch Rooftop.
